tools.name: get_tasks
tools.description: Today/tomorrow tasks with id, date and priority. Call first to get refs.

tools.name: create_tasks
tools.description: Create tasks, each with optional nested subtasks. Defaults: today, 30 min.

tools.name: update_tasks
tools.description: Change tasks: date (moves the day), priority, title, estimate, done, time slot.

tools.name: delete_tasks
tools.description: Delete tasks by ref, every task on a date, or all completed. Subtasks go too.

tools.name: get_subtasks
tools.description: List subtasks of a parent. Returns ids usable as refs.

tools.name: reorder_subtasks
tools.description: Reorder a parent's subtasks. Pass the complete new order, every one once.

tools.name: get_loops
tools.description: Loops — undated intentions in 4 buckets (pressing/important/backlog/waiting=parked). Call before pull_loops.

tools.name: pull_loops
tools.description: Copy loops onto a date as linked tasks — each loop stays in Loops. Idempotent per loop+date.

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Events + scheduled/unscheduled tasks for a date. Check before scheduling.

tools.name: get_goals
tools.description: Goals by horizon (week/month/year/decade) — exactly what the app's Goals view shows.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a goal in a horizon, with optional bottleneck note and lever.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Update goal fields: title, horizon (moves section), status, bottleneckNote, lever.

tools.name: delete_goal
tools.description: Delete a goal by id. Linked tasks are kept and unlinked, never deleted.

tools.name: get_focus_stats
tools.description: Today/week focus minutes, streak, task completion rates.

tools.name: get_journal
tools.description: Read the user's daily journal note (markdown). Also lists recent days.

tools.name: write_journal
tools.description: Write the user's daily journal note. Prefer mode=append; replace overwrites the whole day.
